note: a 51,200 triangle ElevationGrid under a TouchSensor: the pick with the three-mesh-bvh bounds tree equals the plain raycast at three points (the plain cast really runs without the tree), and exactly one tree is built
gaps: three.js bridge only: the bounds tree is built by the three-mesh-bvh library when it is on the page (window.MeshBVHLib); the Babylon bridge picks by its own engine

js: (() => { const P = __R.bridge.three.pointer, b = __body; b.bvhOn = true; const a = P.pick(b, 160, 120), n = b.pickStats.treeMeshes; b.bvhOn = false; const c = P.pick(b, 160, 120); const plain = b.pickStats.treeMeshes; b.bvhOn = true; return plain === 0 && !!a && !!c && Math.hypot(a.point.x - c.point.x, a.point.y - c.point.y, a.point.z - c.point.z) < 1e-6 && n >= 1 && a.mesh === c.mesh; })()
